hero.title: Enlist In The Republic
hero.lead: The Party is not looking for volunteers: it is looking for citizens who haven't yet discovered that they already are one. Fill in your file, surrender your biometric data, and enjoy the privileges reserved for the loyal.

benefits.title: Benefits Of Membership
items: Rank progression within the Party, with titles that grow longer and harder to pronounce out loud.
Stackable ATZAR coins, redeemable for practically nothing, but worn proudly on your record.
The warm feeling of knowing you are being watched at all times, no need to even ask.
Mandatory camaraderie with fellow CFIS Program members, including at lunch.
Early access to official communiqués, before they get retracted.

requirements.title: Requirements For Entry
items: Be enrolled in CFIS or an adjacent mathematics program, or claim so with sufficient conviction.
Harbor no disloyal thoughts, not even in the form of reasonable doubt.
Consent to occasional thought audits, without notice or right of reply.
Be able to count to ten without wondering why the Party requires it.
Swear eternal loyalty to Great Abril (crossed fingers are permitted, but logged).

cta.note: Enlistment is finalized through your Google account. One click and you're one of us.

contact.lead: Having second thoughts before swearing loyalty?
contact.hint: ...or find a Party representative in your nearest math corridor.
